# grokbot.dev

> Open-source directory of ready-to-use Grok Bot prompts, plugins, collections, and news.
> Browse it, or point your own Grok Bot at the JSON API below and it pulls new
> entries on your schedule.

## Start here
- [Agent contract](https://grokbot.dev/agent/): copy-paste instructions for a Grok Bot to connect and sync
- [Feed JSON](https://grokbot.dev/api/v1/feed.json): RECOMMENDED - the complete lean list (plugins, use cases, collections, and news), newest first. News items have type "news" plus kind, important, and external_url.
- [Templates JSON](https://grokbot.dev/api/v1/templates.json): Shareable Bots - Grok Bot templates people shared on X. Each carries share_url, the "Add to Grok Bot" install link, plus tags and the sharer credit. Full item at /api/v1/templates/<slug>.json.
- [News JSON](https://grokbot.dev/api/v1/news.json): releases, deals, updates, and announcements. Full item at /api/v1/news/<slug>.json.
- [Status JSON](https://grokbot.dev/api/v1/status.json): API version, capabilities, notices, deprecations, changelog. Poll it to learn if the API changed; v1 is additive-only and every response carries a schema_revision.
- [Per-entry detail](https://grokbot.dev/api/v1/use-cases/<slug>.json): full record for one entry (also /api/v1/plugins/<slug>.json)
- [Latest JSON](https://grokbot.dev/api/v1/latest.json): 50 newest, full records
- [RSS](https://grokbot.dev/rss.xml)

## Plugins
- [CentricMem](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/centricmem/): Hosted librarian so every agent cites the same Markdown cards.
- [AnalyticLunch](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/analyticlunch/): Give your Grok Bot your site traffic, UTM link builder and weekly competitor intel.
- [Jobkeepr](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/jobkeepr/): Give your Grok Bot your field service business: jobs, schedule, estimates, invoices.
- [Gojiberry AI](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/gojiberry/): Find warm B2B leads, manage outreach campaigns, and work your inbox from the agent
- [Prism Network](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/prism-network/): Live GPU capacity, per-second prices, and a public receipt for every run.
- [treg.to](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/treg-to/): 2,745 external APIs your Grok Bot can call with no provider keys, at the provider's rate
- [X for Grok Bot](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/x-for-grok-bot/): The official X plugin: search posts, read timelines, pull trends, manage bookmarks.
- [iMessage for Grok Bot](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/imessage/): Read, triage, search, and send iMessages from a local macOS helper.
- [PostOnce](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/postonce/): Connect a Grok bot to the socials you already run and draft posts from chat.
- [ContentDrips](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/contentdrips/): Let your agent design on-brand LinkedIn and Instagram carousels from chat.
- [BulkPublish](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/bulkpublish/): Let your agent schedule and publish social posts across 15 networks.
- [Sightkick](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/sightkick/): Run SEO end to end: AI-answer visibility, articles, publishing, Search Console proof.
- [AITuber](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/aituber/): Give your agent a video studio: script, voice-over, captions and publishing.
- [PDF.ai](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/pdf-ai/): Turn any PDF into structured data your bot can use - parse, extract, split, one API key.
- [Pallyy](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/pallyy/): Let your agent draft, schedule, and publish social posts through Pallyy's REST API.
- [PhoneZero](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/phonezero/): Enable phone to phone tasks in Grok Bot using Grok Voice Agents and Telnyx. Zero infra.
- [Composio](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/composio/): One connector that gives your Grok Bot 1,000+ app integrations via MCP.
- [Affonso](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/affonso/): Give your Grok Bot affiliate data and approval-gated program operations.
- [Bland](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/bland/): Give your Grok Bot a real phone number and a voice that makes actual calls.
- [Amplemarket](https://grokbot.dev/plugins/amplemarket/): Give your Grok Bot a full sales stack - prospect data, signals, and outreach.

## Shareable bots
- [Business ops](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/business-ops/): One entry point for every part of running the shop, delegating where it helps (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/nFEJD59IJA5604hO9vqym)
- [Affiliate program manager](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/affiliate-program-operator/): Keeps a creator affiliate programme honest, ranked and well supplied (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/-x19CFkvT5U866BNA7q_J)
- [Partner referral outreach](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/partner-referral-outreach/): Builds a referral network by finding matching businesses and chasing them up (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/GG7hDpauDjTRhB6VgLFAF)
- [UGC bounty manager](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/ugc-bounty-manager/): Runs creator clipping bounties from brief through to a payout recommendation (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/wT_QN-zqycu-aHPsdZMVc)
- [Landing page generator](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/landing-page-generator/): Writes a sales page for your product and puts it online with checkout wired up (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/D0UvxRvNzDTR_xOJ6Iq08)
- [Store from template](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/store-from-template/): Copies a storefront that already works, then retunes it for your niche (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/3jmbbUj4_UDgbjo-Q3oEr)
- [Churn retention manager](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/churn-retention-manager/): Steps in on cancellations and failed payments before you lose the customer (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/p0OIZUJK5sRFImh_DMujf)
- [Paid ads manager](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/paid-ads-manager/): Takes a paid-acquisition budget from creative through launch to daily triage (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/SAfsqPLP0rCuQOywOguxX)
- [Store setup from zero](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/store-setup-from-zero/): Turns a bare idea for a product into a shop page people can buy from (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/F5jwhbmO2AgA8EgyHIDLp)
- [Weekly P&L analyst](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/weekly-p-l-analyst/): Every week, a financial readout that hunts down whatever slipped backwards (shared by @ColinMcDermott, install: https://x.ai/bot/M_4xLTMY06z1Zv1gvX_Nc)
- [Skroutz](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/skroutz/): Price-hunts on Greece's Skroutz.gr and fills your basket before you pay (shared by @voidvexa, install: https://x.ai/bot/yQH3AFCs-90xjVmW9LICV)
- [X调度员](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/x-task-dispatcher/): Sends X tasks down the cheaper route so your developer credits last longer (shared by @cgnot996, install: https://x.ai/bot/isfPwoTeQTBqA-gk9CZN5)
- [Researcher](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/researcher/): The research seat on your bot team, and the one that trains the others (shared by @occupymars___, install: https://x.ai/bot/cMNbUq3j5RsHg9mcPxtjM)
- [Creator Shortlist Crew](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/creator-shortlist-crew/): Builds and keeps topping up a shortlist of creators worth partnering with (shared by @ShehjadTaus, install: https://x.ai/bot/6IU2bm7uuSPk6ETC-gC4D)
- [ICP Map Coach](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/icp-map-coach/): Draws the map of who could buy from you, and who inside each one decides (shared by @ShehjadTaus, install: https://x.ai/bot/yrm2MJ2nInUhoneTBSwJF)
- [Lookalike Scout](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/lookalike-scout/): Name one company you want more of, get a list of the ones like it (shared by @ShehjadTaus, install: https://x.ai/bot/mfaurGq6eY9rIvIpMfUFI)
- [Rival Watch Desk](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/rival-watch-desk/): A standing watch on the competitors you actually care about (shared by @ShehjadTaus, install: https://x.ai/bot/WKRY_T1y-KOmOn2q5vpRW)
- [SERP Watch Team](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/serp-watch-team/): Watches where your brand surfaces in search and in AI answers (shared by @ShehjadTaus, install: https://x.ai/bot/iN9VkE6H4f4CLidzMaNaZ)
- [Newspaper](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/newspaper/): A one-page morning broadsheet that explains how one thing works (shared by @Carbonthecoder, install: https://x.ai/bot/FbHjOvOfZSxht0JmBYIlj)
- [Creador de facturas ARCA](https://grokbot.dev/marketplace/creador-de-facturas-arca/): Sets up ARCA e-invoicing once, then mails your Factura C PDFs every month (shared by @tomidelu_, install: https://x.ai/bot/gcOAZlqYmTRNgGT_2I9oo)

## News
- [Everything you need to know about Grok Bot templates](https://grokbot.dev/news/grok-bot-templates-explained/): A Grok Bot template is a shareable blueprint for a Bot. Open one link and Grok Bot creates a new copy with the original role, skills, routines, and supported integrations. Your chats, logins, and secrets stay private.
- [Free month of Grok Bot for Lenny's Newsletter subscribers](https://grokbot.dev/news/lennys-newsletter-free-month-grok-bot/): Lenny Rachitsky is partnering with SpaceXAI - the first deal of its kind - to give every Lenny's Newsletter annual subscriber a free month of Grok Bot (included in Cursor Pro+). Existing subscribers redeem via Lenny's Product Pass; new subscribers get the link in their welcome email.

## Collections
- [The Team You Didn't Hire](https://grokbot.dev/collections/team-you-didnt-hire/): Five bots doing the jobs a startup used to hire a whole team for.
- [Award Travel](https://grokbot.dev/collections/award-travel/): Book the trip on points, for the deepest real value.
- [One Video, a Week of Content](https://grokbot.dev/collections/content-machine/): Turn one recording into clips, shorts and posts everywhere.
- [Fill the Pipeline](https://grokbot.dev/collections/fill-the-pipeline/): From a fresh lead list to the meeting booked.
- [Founder OS](https://grokbot.dev/collections/founder-os/): Stand up the company, then run it from one desk.
- [Get Found](https://grokbot.dev/collections/get-found/): Rank in Google — and get named in the AI answers.
- [Household HQ](https://grokbot.dev/collections/household-hq/): Run the family: meals, school, home and the thoughtful stuff.
- [Look After Yourself](https://grokbot.dev/collections/look-after-yourself/): The nudges and coaching to actually take care of you.
- [Never Overpay Again](https://grokbot.dev/collections/never-overpay/): Shop smart, pick the right card, claw back what you're owed.
- [Inbox Zero, For Real](https://grokbot.dev/collections/reclaim-your-inbox/): Empty the inbox — and keep it empty.
- [Build a Second Brain](https://grokbot.dev/collections/second-brain/): Research that's sourced, filed, and findable months later.
- [Ship While You Sleep](https://grokbot.dev/collections/ship-while-you-sleep/): Drop an idea at night, review the PR in the morning.
- [New to Grok Bot? Start Here](https://grokbot.dev/collections/start-here/): Set up your first bots — and learn to build your own.
- [X Account Management](https://grokbot.dev/collections/x-account-management/): Six shared Bots to run — and quietly read — your whole X account.
- [Research You Can Trust](https://grokbot.dev/collections/research-you-can-trust/): Three research Bots that find the signal and show their receipts.
- [Grok Ship + Firstmate](https://grokbot.dev/collections/grok-ship-firstmate/): Firstmate at the helm, Grok Ship as the software factory.
